arturo: Strange repro: monorepo (pnpm workspace) app uses redwood-js-sdk via workspace: link. Dev server OK, but production Edge bundle (Vite -> Cloudflare Pages) crashes with 'ReferenceError: require is not defined'.

meena: Did you accidentally ship the CJS build from the workspace link? pnpm symlinks can expose the package's src or cjs dist.

arturo: Minimal details: app package.json has "type":"module". SDK is workspace: ^0.18.0. Build uses Vite with optimizeDeps disabled for linked packages. Error happens only when bundler resolves via symlink.

zane: Quick checks: 1) run `node -p "require.resolve('redwood-js-sdk/package.json')"` to see which entry is picked; 2) ensure SDK has conditional exports in package.json so bundlers prefer dist/esm.

meena: Workarounds that helped me: a) in vite.config set `resolve: { preserveSymlinks: false }` so resolution mimics published package, b) `ssr: { noExternal: ['redwood-js-sdk'] }` to force ESM bundling.

arturo: TS also warned: "TS1259: Module 'redwood-js-sdk' can only be default-imported using the 'esModuleInterop' flag." Editor mismatch + runtime failure.

zane: Long term SDK fix: publish separate dist/esm and dist/cjs, add conditional "exports" map, and include interop-friendly d.ts that declares a default export. Also add CI that builds against pnpm workspace linking to catch symlink resolution issues.

ci-bot: Created issue #489: "redwood-js-sdk: pnpm workspace symlink -> bundler resolves CJS, edge runtime fails" and attached repro notes.
